description: Sample dashboard for exploring the Gaia stellar catalog via ADQL

targets.adqlQuery:
SELECT source_id, ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag, parallax, pmra, pmdec
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 266.4, -29.0, 1.0)) = 1
  AND phot_g_mean_mag < 15
ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC

SELECT pmra, pmdec
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 266.4, -29.0, 0.5)) = 1
  AND pmra IS NOT NULL
  AND pmdec IS NOT NULL
  AND pmra BETWEEN -20 AND 20
  AND pmdec BETWEEN -20 AND 20

SELECT COUNT(*) AS star_count
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 266.4, -29.0, 1.0)) = 1

SELECT
  bp_rp,
  phot_g_mean_mag + 5*LOG10(parallax) - 10 AS abs_mag
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE parallax > 10
  AND parallax_over_error > 10
  AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL

SELECT
  bp_rp,
  phot_g_mean_mag
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE CONTAINS(
    POINT('ICRS', ra, dec),
    CIRCLE('ICRS', 56.75, 24.12, 3.0)
  ) = 1
  AND pmra  BETWEEN 15  AND 25
  AND pmdec BETWEEN -52 AND -38
  AND parallax BETWEEN 5 AND 9
  AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL
  AND phot_g_mean_mag IS NOT NULL

  ) = 1
  AND pmra  IS NOT NULL
  AND pmdec IS NOT NULL

SELECT ra, dec, bp_rp, phot_g_mean_mag

    CIRCLE('ICRS', 56.75, 24.12, 3.0)
  ) = 1
  AND pmra  BETWEEN 15  AND 25
  AND pmdec BETWEEN -52 AND -38
  AND parallax BETWEEN 6.5 AND 8.5
